dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you guarantee that the liquor you sell does indeed come from the fae?

dialogues.speaker: Savva
dialogues.text: Oh, absolutely! This is the real deal, the good stuff brewed by them fae folks in Novokitezhgrad. Don't pay too much mind to that price tag, I'm telling you. You're getting a total steal here.

dialogues.speaker: Savva
dialogues.text: Look, if we were back in the days of the Belyi Tsar, only the aristocrats would've ever gotten to enjoy a drink this good.

dialogues.speaker: Savva
dialogues.text: But these days, as long as you've got enough Mora in your pocket, you can have a real good time with a bottle like this.
